# hvrg_source (Resource)

The source records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (String) what the source is: a sink, a poller or a read kind
- `name` (String) display name

### Optional

- `api_spec` (Dynamic) the OpenAPI document of an openapi source
- `auth` (Dynamic) how the source authenticates, without the secret values
- `color` (String) hex color the source is drawn in
- `columns` (Dynamic) column descriptors of a polled table shaped source
- `config` (Dynamic) per kind settings
- `connection` (Dynamic) poll_ms, max_entries and trailing_window
- `description` (String) free text shown with the source
- `mapping` (Dynamic) how polled items map onto logs, metrics, spans or records
- `owner_id` (String) owning organization
- `secrets` (Attributes) credential values, stored by Samna Auth, written and never read back (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secrets))
- `state` (String) draft, active, erroneous, unauthorized or disabled

<a id="nestedatt--secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secrets`

Optional:

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `token` (String, Sensitive)
